evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server authentication logic in src/httprpc.cpp.
rationale: Prevents denial of service where unauthenticated clients can tie up all HTTP RPC worker threads by submitting requests with invalid credentials. Removing the obsolete 250 ms UninterruptibleSleep directly addresses resource exhaustion in the HTTP server, which is explicitly prioritized in the RPC area.
